title: generateMock is imported from document-model/mock, not from @powerhousedao/codegen or the document-model root
content:
Document-model tests generate schema-aware inputs with `generateMock`, and where it comes from changed. All three Academy pages that teach reducer tests were corrected in v6.2.2-dev.74 to the same import:

```ts
import { generateMock } from "document-model/mock";
```

Previously the tutorials showed `from "@powerhousedao/codegen"` (Manual Todo step 4, Chatroom reducers) or `from "document-model"` (Document Model Creation step 6). `packages/document-model/package.json` declares `./mock` as its own export (`source: ./mock.ts`, `import: ./dist/mock.js`, `types: ./dist/mock.d.ts`), so the mock generator is a subpath of the document-model package rather than something the codegen package re-exports.

The surrounding pattern is unchanged: create a document with `utils.createDocument()`, build inputs with `generateMock(AddTodoItemInputSchema())`, apply the reducer, assert on state — and read reducer errors off `document.operations.global[i].error` rather than expecting a throw.
